title: In Georgia, niche fragrances appeal to consumers seeking exclusivity
summary: In Georgia, as elsewhere, the niche fragrance market is growing rapidly. Rising demand is driving the opening of new, highly selective boutiques, alongside the emergence of local brands that remain relatively under the radar. Meanwhile, the trade in dupes and counterfeit fragrances is also benefiting from this broader enthusiasm. A closer look at the market in Tbilisi. title: ACT Beauty develops a sculpting Gua Sha with a built-in massage ball for Nuxe
summary: ACT Beauty has designed and manufactured for Nuxe a sculpting Gua Sha combined with a roller ball. It is offered with the purchase of the two concentrates in the Super Serum [10] range, and all three are presented together in a gift box. Gold-plated zamak This jewel-like tool is made of gold-plated zamak, a material valued for its cooling, tightening effect.
